text: Kick-off. The match hasn't started yet. Kick-off is at four.
Half-time. It's half-time and nobody has scored yet.
Chant. The fans have just started a new chant.
The stands. We have never sat that high in the stands.
Referee. The referee has already shown two yellow cards.
Penalty. Have you ever taken a penalty?
Equaliser. They have just scored the equaliser!
Scarf. I have had this scarf since I was eight.
Half-time! Have you seen the score yet?
Yes! I have just seen it. Two to one! Who scored?
The first one came from a penalty. The second one was amazing.
I have already watched the replay three times. Best goal of the year!
Have you ever been to a match this important?
Yes, I have. I went to a final with my dad two years ago.
What happened? Did your team win?
We lost, but the chants were incredible. I lost my voice for two days.
They have just scored!
Nobody has scored yet.
I have already seen it three times.
Have you ever been to a match? Yes, I went last year!
It is the best goal I have ever seen.

Sophia, it is Ruby! I am at the stadium with my uncle, and it is crazy. The match has just started, and the fans have already sung the same chant five times. I have never seen so many people in one place. We are high up in the stands, so the players look tiny. Nobody has scored yet, but the referee has already shown a yellow card, after six minutes. Oh, and I have bought a scarf. It is red and black, so you are going to love it. I will send you a video at half-time!
